sponsored.t: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways
sponsored.sum: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn located on state route 941-A in the town of Greece, county of Monroe.

sponsored.t: Bolsters the use of hydrogen in relation to the state energy plan
sponsored.sum: Bolsters the use of hydrogen in relation to the state energy plan; directs various agencies to develop and implement plans for the use of hydrogen power.

sponsored.t: Establishes the everyone can play grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the everyone can play grant program which allows for grants up to $100,000 to municipalities to cover the costs for the creation of handicap accessible aspects in new or existing recreation facilities.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Parma, county of Monroe, to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Daniel Rizzo
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Daniel Rizzo.

sponsored.t: Requires the court to treat the date of dissolution as if a spouse retired from employment with New York state when calculating the distribution of a pension
sponsored.sum: Requires the court to treat the date of dissolution as if a spouse retired from employment with New York state when calculating the distribution of a pension for the purposes of divorce.

sponsored.t: Requires health plan coverage to include certain generic drugs and biosimilars
sponsored.sum: Requires health plan coverage to include generic drugs and biosimilars where the wholesale acquisition cost of such generic drugs or biosimilars is lower than the brand drug's wholesale acquisition cost.

sponsored.t: Relates to the identification of individuals who provide face-to-face care to or direct observation of a patient
sponsored.sum: Limits the identification of individuals who provide face-to-face care to or direct observation of a patient to their employee identification number, first name and first initial of last name when full name identification may place the personal safety of such individual in jeopardy.

sponsored.t: Expands the amount of information required in client service reports
sponsored.sum: Expands the amount of information required in client service reports to include the identity of persons who assist a client or patient.

sponsored.t: Extends paid family leave benefits to members of the New York national guard
sponsored.sum: Extends paid family leave benefits to members of the New York army national guard and New York air national guard.

sponsored.t: Requires fire district elections occur on the same day as school board elections and be run by the county board of elections; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires fire district elections occur on the same day as school board elections and requires that such voting day follows similar procedures to early voting; requires such election be overseen by the local county board of elections.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Civil War veteran John B. Nicholas
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on state route five hundred thirty-one, crossing over route two hundred fifty-nine, otherwise known as, South Union Street, in the town of Ogden, county of Monroe, to Civil War Veteran John B. Nichols.

sponsored.t: Directs the the state board of real property tax services to conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts
sponsored.sum: Directs the state board of real property tax services conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts and provide a report for such study.

sponsored.t: Provides for initiative and referendum in New York State for the People as electors to propose or reject laws and submit amendments to the state constitution
sponsored.sum: Provides for initiative and referendum in New York State for the People as electors to propose or reject laws and submit amendments to the state constitution.

sponsored.t: Relates to the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor
sponsored.sum: Requires the filling of vacancies in the office of lieutenant-governor be done subject to confirmation by a two-thirds vote in the senate and a two-thirds vote in the assembly.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to integrate blockchain technology into its New York state of health marketplace and statewide health information network for New York
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on and then integrate blockchain technology into its New York state of health marketplace and statewide health information network for New York and improve interoperability of these two platforms.

sponsored.t: Directs the chief information officer conduct a study on the feasibility of utilizing blockchain technology in the state government
sponsored.sum: Directs the chief information officer conduct a study on the feasibility of utilizing blockchain technology in the state government and provide a report on its findings.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to appear biannually in front of the relevant legislative committees
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to appear biannually in front of the relevant legislative committee; defines state agency.

sponsored.t: Establishes the fire station construction grant program and the fire station construction fund; and makes an appropriation therefor
sponsored.sum: Establishes the fire station construction grant program and the fire station construction fund; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Establishes requirements for school libraries
sponsored.sum: Requires elementary and secondary school libraries provide equitable access to physical and digital media.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the court to order sexual offenders on probation to terms of imprisonment which run consecutively to sentences already being served
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the court to order sexual offenders on probation, where such probation has been revoked, to terms of imprisonment which run consecutively to sentences already being served.

sponsored.t: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine in the waters of Lake Ontario located within the state
sponsored.sum: Establishes a moratorium on the building or placing of any permanent or semi-permanent wind turbine in the waters of Lake Ontario located within the state and within the jurisdiction and control of the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to sex offender registration of change of address and internet accounts
sponsored.sum: Requires sex offenders to register information no later than three days after any changes; requires local law enforcement to submit all change of address and internet access provider forms to the registry.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing certain relief for persons who are victims of identity theft
sponsored.sum: Provides certain relief for persons who are victims of identity theft; provides for destruction or sealing of certain police and court records and for issuance of an identity theft passport.

sponsored.t: Relates to being absent from full time day instruction for the purpose of sounding Taps at a military honors funeral held in this state
sponsored.sum: Provides that a minor from six to sixteen years being absent from full time day instruction for the purpose of sounding "Taps" at a military honors funeral held in this state for a deceased veteran shall be excused from school.

sponsored.t: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill certain monetary commitments
sponsored.sum: Requires the dormitory authority of the state of New York to fulfill all outstanding monetary commitments made to any local government for a fiscal year prior to allocating any moneys to economic development grant programs for the following fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Awards grants to municipalities for capital improvement projects; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Awards grants to municipalities for any non-transportation related capital improvement projects with a maximum cumulative grant award not exceeding $250,000; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires certain teachers who provide literacy instruction obtain a literacy endorsement
sponsored.sum: Requires certain teachers who provide literacy instruction obtain a literacy endorsement.

sponsored.t: Provides a partial exemption from real property taxes for special police officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a partial tax exemption from real property taxes for real property owned by special police officers residing in any county, excluding any county wholly contained in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to the filling of vacancies in the office of attorney general or comptroller
sponsored.sum: Requires the filling of vacancies in the office of attorney general or comptroller be done by a two-thirds majority of each house.

sponsored.t: Establishes training and registration requirements for patient care technicians
sponsored.sum: Establishes training and registration requirements for patient care technicians; requires training programs to be conducted by hospitals, residential health care facilities, home care services agencies, degree and non-degree granting institutions of higher education, or any other entity approved by the commissioner to conduct such a program; provides such training shall include, but not be limited to an overview of the roles and responsibilities of patient care technicians in hospitals, residential care facilities and the home care environment, an overview of various patient care services provided in hospitals, residential care facilities and the home care environment, and the legal scope…

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for widowed spouses of firefighters killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residences of widowed spouses of firefighters killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Creates the legislative office of fiscal transparency; requires fiscal notes on proposed rules and executive orders affecting political subdivisions
sponsored.sum: Creates the legislative office of fiscal transparency; requires fiscal notes on proposed rules and executive orders affecting political subdivisions; requires legislative committee approval of certain proposed rules; requires the comptroller to make monthly reports to the legislative office of fiscal transparency.

sponsored.t: Enacts the single opportunity for legislative equality (SOLE) act
sponsored.sum: Entitles each member of the legislature to bring one statewide piece of legislation of the member's choosing to the floor for a vote without a home rule message and committee review during each two-year term.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting eligibility for limited credit time allowances to those incarcerated individuals having completed eighty percent of their original sentence
sponsored.sum: Relates to limiting eligibility for limited credit time allowances to those incarcerated individuals having completed eighty percent of their original sentence.

sponsored.t: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to certain pupils
sponsored.sum: Requires all public and private schools to provide financial literacy education to pupils in grade eleven; directs that certain topics be covered in such educational program.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving the twenty-four hour waiting period for solemnizing a marriage after a license is issued for persons serving in the armed forces; repealer
sponsored.sum: Waives the twenty-four hour waiting period for solemnizing a marriage after a license is issued for persons serving in the armed forces.

sponsored.t: Provides distinctive license plates for members of the Seabee Veterans of America
sponsored.sum: Provides for distinctive license plates for members of the Seabee Veterans of America.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of criminal use of weapons; firing into a crowded space
sponsored.sum: Makes it a class B violent felony to fire a gun into a crowded space with the intent to harm or absent the intent to harm when such an act creates a great risk of death to one or more people within the crowded space; establishes the crime of criminal use of weapons; firing into a crowded space.

sponsored.t: Directs revenue from certain mobile casino gaming activities to be used for school safety and security purposes
sponsored.sum: Directs revenue from certain mobile casino gaming activities to be used for school safety and security purposes.

sponsored.t: Permits certain nurses to perform medication related tasks provided by a certified medication aide
sponsored.sum: Permits certain nurses to perform medication related tasks provided by a certified medication aide.

sponsored.t: Relates to making it unlawful for a caretaker to post a vulnerable elderly person on social media without such elderly person's consent
sponsored.sum: Relates to making it unlawful for a caretaker to post a vulnerable elderly person on social media without their consent.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax holiday for various products for the period commencing on Black Friday and ending after Christmas day
sponsored.sum: Establishes a sales tax exemption for certain products purchased for less than five hundred dollars commencing on the fourth Friday in November and ending on the twenty-sixth day of December.

sponsored.t: Prohibits price gouging on certain consumer goods sold at thruway gas stations, restaurants, and other facilities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits price gouging on certain consumer goods sold at thruway gas stations, restaurants, and other facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes an annual spending growth cap
sponsored.sum: Establishes an annual spending growth cap.

sponsored.t: Continues the New York state pathways in technology early college high school program in this state
sponsored.sum: Continues the New York State Pathways in Technology Early College High School Program in this state; requires the commissioner to allocate funds for new P-TECH programs for the purposes of preparing eligible academically at-risk and/or economically disadvantaged students for high-skill jobs.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child and provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child; increases age from 16 to 18 for application of existing sexual performance crimes; creates crimes of use of a child in a sexual performance in the first degree, promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child in the first degree, and promoting a sexual performance by a child in the first degree; provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions.

sponsored.t: Requires certain handicap accessible playground equipment in each playground within each state park
sponsored.sum: Requires at least one handicap accessible swing set in each state park.

sponsored.t: Requires new teachers to have completed training for evidence-based reading instruction
sponsored.sum: Requires new teachers applying for certification or a license including childhood education teachers, early education teachers, special education teachers, or reading specialists to have completed training for evidence-based reading instruction.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a distinctive "guardians for schools" license plate; and establishes the guardians for schools fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a distinctive "guardians for schools" license plate; establishes the guardians for schools fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission
sponsored.sum: Provides that the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission shall: evaluate each mandated benefit; investigate current practices of health plans with regard to the mandated benefit; investigate the potential premium impact of repealing and/or modifying the mandated benefits on all segments of the insurance market; hold at least two public hearings; submit a report to the legislature; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Includes certain veterans in the definition of resident as it relates to community colleges and state-aided four-year colleges
sponsored.sum: Includes active duty military and certain veterans going to college under the new GI bill in the definition of resident as it relates to community colleges and state-aided four-year colleges.

sponsored.t: Adds additional objects which a person would be guilty of criminally using drug paraphernalia in the 2nd degree if he or she knowingly possesses or sells such object
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding additional objects which a person would be guilty of criminally using drug paraphernalia in the second degree if such person knowingly possesses or sells such objects.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a non-traditional hours model
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a non-traditional hours model; provides that the office of children and family services shall: create a non-traditional hours model within a year, publish its findings on its website, and conduct a review of child care providers and centers that use such model.

sponsored.t: Provides expanded enrollment through New York state of health through tax returns, expands New York state of health navigator program; creates the New York health benefit and cost commission; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides expanded enrollment through New York state of health through tax returns (Part A); allows for enrollment through the New York state of health at any time for first-time enrollees; expands New York state of health navigator program (Part B); creates the New York health benefit and cost commission (Part C); establishes New York health care savings accounts to expand and incentivize purchasing private health insurance (Part D).

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of resisting arrest
sponsored.sum: Relates to the crime of resisting arrest; provides that a second violation within 5 years shall be a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Creates the task force on early childhood education in public education
sponsored.sum: Creates the task force on early childhood education in public education to study the feasibility of incorporating younger age levels into the state public education system and extending the public education system to start at the age of six months and incorporate aspects of childcare and early childhood education into the existing public education system.

sponsored.t: Relates to grants for facilities providing prekindergarten services
sponsored.sum: Relates to grants for facilities providing prekindergarten services; promotes the financial viability of such facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal history records of maintenance employees in adult residential health and assisted living facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to criminal history records of maintenance employees in adult residential health and assisted living facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain statewide literacy education programs
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain statewide literacy education programs including standards for an early education program, statewide parents as teachers program, a reading program to provide direct support for and intervention in intensive reading intervention services, and the district reading intervention program.

sponsored.t: Increases the total awards of the Senator Patricia K. McGee nursing faculty scholarship program
sponsored.sum: Increases the total awards of the Senator Patricia K. McGee nursing faculty scholarship program by covering the total cost of a recipient's academic program.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain credits against income tax for nurses
sponsored.sum: Establishes a five hundred dollar credit against income tax for nurses employed on a full-time basis for not less than six months and nurses teaching at institutions of higher education on and after January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing any moneys derived from new or increased taxes to reduce local real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Directs any moneys derived from new or increased taxes be used to reduce local real property taxes.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state short-term rental property commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state short-term rental property commission which shall assess and address the current housing stock in the state of New York and the state of short-term rental property regulation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the drinking water quality institute to make recommendations to the department of health relating to ensuring the safety of potable water
sponsored.sum: Establishes the drinking water quality institute to make recommendations to the department of health relating to ensuring the safety of potable water.

sponsored.t: Provides for establishment of school speed limits by county legislative body
sponsored.sum: Provides for the establishment of school speed limits of not less than fifteen miles per hour by the legislative body of any county or, if so delegated, by the legislative body of any locality within said county on a portion of a state highway, county or town road passing a school building.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Freedom of Choice in Health Care Act"
sponsored.sum: Preserves New Yorker's freedom of choice in health care.

sponsored.t: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts
sponsored.sum: Allows for in-state suppliers to receive preference in certain situations when the state is awarding contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board, and to oversight of registered cannabis organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to appointments to the cannabis control board; relates to seed-to-sale tracking and reporting for registered cannabis organizations; relates to state and local inspections of registered cannabis organizations.

sponsored.t: Requires student athletes participating in public school sponsored athletics complete anti-bullying, anti-hazing and anti-harassment training
sponsored.sum: Requires student athletes participating in public school sponsored athletics complete anti-bullying, anti-hazing and anti-harassment training.

sponsored.t: Extends the time where certain entities can provide fiscal intermediary services
sponsored.sum: Extends the time where certain entities can provide fiscal intermediary services to July 1, 2025.

sponsored.t: Provides a personal income tax exemption for certain professional athletes residing in New York state
sponsored.sum: Provides a personal income tax exemption for certain professional athletes residing in New York state of up to two hundred fifty thousand dollars of income.

sponsored.t: Permits certain out-of-state clinical laboratories to accept specimens from New York when there are no proper labs within the state
sponsored.sum: Permits out-of-state clinical laboratories located within the United States to accept specimens from New York when there are no proper labs within the state recognized by the department of health.

sponsored.t: Exempts the income of dependent applicants for certain awards
sponsored.sum: Exempts the income of dependent applicants from their eligibility determination for excelsior scholarship and tuition assistance program awards and makes adjustments to certain award reduction schedules.

sponsored.t: Requires community service as a condition of release of incarcerated individuals due to prison staffing shortages
sponsored.sum: Requires community service as a condition of early release of incarcerated individuals due to prison staff shortages.

sponsored.t: Defines academic excellence relating to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program
sponsored.sum: Defines academic excellence relating to the New York state masters-in-education teacher incentive scholarship program as having a grade point average of three and one half or more on a four point scale.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York health benefit and cost commission; repealer
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York health benefit and cost commission to review and report on utilization rates, public and patient health effects, and impact on premiums and access to health care and health coverage of all existing and proposed mandated health benefits.

sponsored.t: Provides expanded enrollment through New York state of health through tax returns, and allowing for first-time enrollees to enroll at any time
sponsored.sum: Provides expanded enrollment through New York state of health through tax returns, and allows for enrollment through the New York state of health at any time for first-time enrollees.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York health care savings act which authorizes the establishment of health care savings accounts to allow residents to save money for the payment of qualified health care related expenses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the establishment of New York health care savings accounts to allow residents of the state to save money for the payment of qualified health care related expenses; relates to the use, maintenance, and tax liability of such accounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to entities who serve as navigators that can help individuals apply for health insurance
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Marketplace to award grants to entities to serve as navigators that can help individuals apply for health insurance.
